description: Example excerpt: every route, the state fallbacks and the REORG disruption suite. The full table is contracts/transitions/routing.v1.json.

routes.basis: HAR-97 pitch §5 candidate list, plus Scene 5 'Expansion readiness NOT YET'.
Product decision: a suspected disruption gets the conservative candidate-style suite.
Product decision (ADR-0012): after a confirmed reorg the risks are a wrong or bypassed owner, pressure on a disrupted relationship and acting without evidence.
Product decision: UNRESOLVED is less certain than CANDIDATE, so it gets the candidate-style conservative suite.

Product decision: a rejected transition leaves the account in from_state, so the from_state's suite applies (state-based fallback); a from_state without a suite (unknown, NEW_LOGO, RENEWAL, RECOVERY) gets the conservative suite.

action_routes.basis: Product decision (HAR-128): an expansion motion proposed while the transition is not confirmed is the one action that needs the expansion-readiness check (expected: NOT YET), whatever state the account is moving to.

reorg_disruption.description: Confirmed reorg: rebuild the relationship around the right owner before any commercial ask (HAR-97 pitch §7 example learning).
